title: Explainability and Hate Speech: Structured Explanations Make Social Media Moderators Faster
reasoning: The paper focuses on the efficiency and speed of human moderators when provided with different types of explanations for hate speech detection. While hate speech is an ethical issue, the research is centered on Human-Computer Interaction (HCI) and Explainable AI (XAI) performance metrics (specifically speed and accuracy) rather than evaluating or benchmarking religious, moral, or ethical frameworks themselves.
